name: TestDouble
summary: Replaces a component the system under test depends on with a test-specific equivalent, so that logic can be verified when what it depends on is unusable or slow.

roles.name: TestDouble
roles.summary: The stand-in for a depended-on component. It is the umbrella the five kinds below narrow: what makes something a test double is that the system under test cannot tell it from the real thing, and the test can. Annotating it is what separates a deliberate stand-in from a class that merely happens to be simple.
